**One TV Launcher 1.0** · build {BUILD} · commit {COMMIT}

A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV and Android TV. See the [README](https://github.com/ChrnX0/one-tv-launcher#readme) for the full tour.

### Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `one-tv-launcher.apk` | 32-bit (`armeabi-v7a`), e.g. Chromecast with Google TV |
| `one-tv-launcher-arm64.apk` | 64-bit (`arm64-v8a`) |

Each APK has a `.sha256` file next to it. Already installed? The launcher updates itself from here.

### Highlights

- Home screen with your apps first, stacks, hidden apps and themes (Live sky, Gallery, Astrolabe, Dark)
- Weather from the nearest airport report plus a three-model rain forecast, and a full-screen forecast
- Alarm clock that turns the TV on, sleep timer, routines, calendar and reminders
- Screensaver with a clock, the weather and your photos
- IPTV (Xtream Codes / M3U) with a guide, movies and series, plus Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, SMB, WebDAV and UPnP
- PIN-protected web panel, optional MCP server for Claude, encrypted nightly backups
- Hold HOME for the quick panel
